title: Burroughs suffers physical effects

tellings.quote: the other Witnesses John buroughs a US Air Force Airman also experienced physical and psychological effects

plain: John Burroughs, a US Air Force airman who was one of the witnesses to strange events in Rendlesham Forest in England in 1980, later suffered physical and psychological effects, Michels says. Michels tells this himself in an episode about UFOs near nuclear bases, without naming a source. If true, it would suggest whatever the airmen met could harm the people near it.
